name: bmad-simple-app
description: ICF generation tool using RAG-based LLM

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.kill: echo 'Killing frontend (3000) and backend (8000)...' && (lsof -ti:3000,8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo 'Processes killed') || echo 'No processes found'
scripts.kill:frontend: echo 'Killing frontend (3000)...' && (lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo 'Frontend killed') || echo 'No process on port 3000'
scripts.kill:backend: echo 'Killing backend (8000)...' && (lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo 'Backend killed') || echo 'No process on port 8000'
